words.tr: n. 大厅；礼堂；门厅；
words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.tr: n. 吃饭；就餐； v. “dine”的现在分词；
words.ex: Dining with family is my favorite time.
words.ex_cn: 和家人一起吃饭是我最喜欢的时间。
words.en: The act of eating a meal, especially dinner.

words.tr: phrase. 在...前面
words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: phrase. 在……对面；与……隔街相对
words.ex: The bank is across from the post office.
words.en: prep. on the opposite side of something

words.tr: n. 健身房；体育馆；
words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr:
n. 领域；田地；场地；运动场；
v. 处理，应付（问题、电话等）；
words.ex: He works in the field of computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他在计算机科学领域工作。
words.en: A field is an area of land that is used for a particular purpose, such as growing crops or playing sports.

words.tr: phrase. 运动场；体育场地
words.ex: The children play soccer on the sports field.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在运动场上踢足球。
words.en: A sports field is a large outdoor area where sports are played, especially at a school or college.

words.tr: n. 办公室
words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.tr: adj. 大的
words.ex: He has a large house.
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.tr: n. 白色书写板；白板
words.ex: The teacher writes on the whiteboard.
words.en: A whiteboard is a shiny white board on which people can write or draw with special pens and then wipe off what they have written.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.tr: adj. 重要的
words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.tr: n. 抽屉；
words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的后面；位于……的背部或后方
words.ex: The cat is at the back of the room.
words.en: Located directly behind something.

words.tr: n. （街道等的）拐角；角；
words.ex: The café is on the corner of Main Street and Oak Avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这家咖啡馆在主街和橡树大道的拐角处。
words.en: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something meet. It can also refer to a difficult situation or to the act of gaining control of a market.

words.tr: n. 书架；书柜；
words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr: 在上学；在学校
words.ex: He is at school now.
words.en: In the location of a school; attending school as a pupil.

words.tr: phrase. 和 ... 不同
words.ex: This book is different from that one.
words.ex_cn: 这本书和那本书不一样。
words.en: To not be the same as something or someone else.

words.tr: adj. 现代的；时髦的；
words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.tr: phrase. 做练习；进行锻炼
words.ex: He does exercises every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上做锻炼来保持健康。
words.en: To engage in physical exertion, especially for training or health.

words.tr: adj. 令人惊异的；令人惊叹的； v. “amaze”的现在分词；
words.ex: The view from the mountain is amazing.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色令人惊异。
words.en: If something is amazing, it is very surprising and makes you feel pleasure or admiration.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.tr:
n. 旗；旗帜；信号旗；
v. 用旗标记；
words.ex: The flag waves in the wind.
words.en: A flag is a piece of cloth with a special design or colors that is used as a symbol, or to give a signal.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.tr: adj. 美味的；
words.ex: The cake tastes delicious.
words.en: If you describe food or drink as delicious, you mean that it has a very pleasant taste.

words.tr: 用于提出建议或征求对方意见，意为“……怎么样？”或“……好不好？”
words.ex: How about going to the park?
words.en: used to make a suggestion or to ask for an opinion

words.tr: pron. 你的；
words.ex: This book is yours.
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.tr: v. 发送；送；寄；
words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.tr: adj. 类似的；相像的；
words.ex: The two dogs are similar in color.
words.ex_cn: 这两只狗的颜色很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr: phrase. 类似于； 与 ... 相似
words.ex: This apple is similar to that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个很相似。
words.en: If one thing is similar to another, or if two things are similar, they have features that are the same.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.tr: phrase. 暂时再见；现在先告辞了
words.ex: I have to leave now, bye for now.
words.en: A casual way to say goodbye, implying a temporary parting.
